description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class within the Installer module of the OrangeHRM project. It manages the pre-render logic for the system check screen during the installation process, setting up a Vue component and updating the application state.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the system check step during the installation process, extending the base installer Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for the system check screen by creating it, adding the necessary properties, and setting it to the controller. Also updates the application state to indicate the current screen.
